hero.sub: The useful question is not what can be automated. It is which automation will materially improve the operation once build cost, maintenance, risk and human oversight are included. We find those opportunities, build them and measure what changes.

sections.heading: What an AI Automation Consultant Does
intro: An AI automation consultant identifies [operational work](/ai-consulting/business-operations) that may benefit from AI or automation, from a single task to end-to-end [AI workflow automation](/ai-consulting/workflow-automation), assesses whether the economics and risks make sense, then helps design, build, deploy and measure the intervention.
That means being willing to reject an automation idea when the manual process is rare, unstable or cheaper to leave alone.

sections.heading: Prioritise AI Automation by Value, Not Novelty
sections.intro: Frequency, time, errors and strategic value are useful inputs, but they are not an automatic scoring answer.

items.title: Frequency
items.body: How often does the work happen and how much cumulative effort does it create?

items.title: Time
items.body: How much human time could realistically be removed or redirected?

items.title: Error and rework
items.body: Where do avoidable mistakes, inconsistency or repeated checking create operational cost?

items.title: Strategic value
items.body: Would improving the workflow create useful capacity or improve a commercially important process?

items.title: Risk and maintenance
items.body: What happens when the automation is wrong, and what will it cost to supervise and maintain?

sections.heading: AI Automation Use Cases Worth Investigating

items.title: Reporting
items.body: Collect, structure and summarise routine information while escalating exceptions.

items.title: Content operations
items.body: Accelerate drafting, repurposing, classification and translation inside an approval process.

items.title: Lead routing
items.body: Use account and interaction context to support prioritisation and routing.

items.title: Meeting administration
items.body: Turn transcripts or notes into structured summaries, actions and CRM-ready information.

items.title: Monitoring
items.body: Watch defined information sources and surface material changes for human review.

items.q: What does an AI automation consultant actually do?
items.a: An AI automation consultant finds processes where AI or automation could create enough value to justify implementation, then helps design, build, deploy and measure the solution. The work includes process diagnosis, prioritisation, tool selection, integration, controls and adoption. A useful consultant should also tell you when an automation is not worth building.

items.q: How do we know if an automation is worth building?
items.a: An automation is worth building when the expected reduction in effort, delay, errors or other operational friction justifies the [AI implementation](/ai-consulting/implementation), software, maintenance and oversight required. Frequency and time saved are useful inputs, but risk and strategic value matter too. We establish a baseline and test the business case before scaling.

items.q: What's the ROI of AI automation for a B2B scale-up?
items.a: There is no universal ROI for AI automation. It depends on the current process, labour involved, transaction volume, error cost, implementation effort, software cost and how much human review remains necessary. The defensible approach is to measure the current workflow, model the expected change and compare that with real results after deployment.

sections.heading: The ability to automate something is not a reason to automate it.
sections.body: Find the work where automation creates enough value to justify its cost, risk and maintenance.
